# Reporting security vulnerabilities

Please [report security vulnerabilities privately through GitHub](https://github.com/azizuysal/simtool/security/advisories/new).

Include the affected SimTool version, macOS version, steps to reproduce, and the potential impact. Use a minimal example without personal data, credentials, or files from a real app container.

SimTool is maintained by one person. Security fixes target the latest release; there is no guaranteed response or resolution time.

Use [GitHub issues](https://github.com/azizuysal/simtool/issues) for ordinary bugs and feature requests.
